title: Order tasks that share a file without a depends_on that blocks one session from claiming both
goal: The runbook and backlog.py give the orchestrator a way to serialize two ready items whose touches overlap (next --all already skips an overlap in flight) without depends_on, or claim --by X accepts an item whose only unmet dependency is claimed by X; nobody edits an item's JSON by hand to drop the dependency. Retrospective of SP-z7a5c76b: a depends_on added only to order TK-qohv7zet after TK-zutzzklq (both touch ql_deliver.py) refused the claim in the one session working both.
